name: saki
description: Saki - supernatural (character-powered) Japanese riichi mahjong: engine, bridge server, and web client

scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.test:client: npm test --workspace web-client && npm run build --workspace web-client
scripts.lint: eslint engine server scripts web-client/src eslint.config.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write engine server scripts web-client/src web-client/*.ts web-client/*.html .github/workflows/ci.yml eslint.config.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check engine server scripts web-client/src web-client/*.ts web-client/*.html .github/workflows/ci.yml eslint.config.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run links
